sentenceSets.sentence: The byzantine approval process frustrated even experienced applicants, who could never learn how many offices a file had to pass through.

answerChoices.reasoning: Convoluted describes something twisted and hard to follow, but the applicants' particular complaint is that they cannot map the hidden chain of offices, which points to intricacy compounded by secrecy.
A rigorous process is demanding but transparent about its standards, whereas these applicants cannot even discover where their file goes.
Protracted means merely long, while the frustration described comes from the number and opacity of the offices involved rather than from elapsed time.
Arbitrary means decided without consistent rules, yet the sentence suggests there are many rules and stages, just too many to trace.
Antiquated would make the process old-fashioned, a charge the sentence never levels; the difficulty lies in its structure, not its age.
Expensive concerns cost, and no fees appear anywhere in the applicants' complaint.
Selective means few applicants succeed, but the frustration here is procedural rather than a matter of low acceptance.
Inconsistent would mean different applicants meet different standards, while these applicants share one maze of offices.
Streamlined means simplified to a minimum of steps, contradicting a file that passes through untold offices.
Transparent would mean applicants could see exactly where their file stood, which the sentence denies.
Effortless conflicts with a process that frustrates even seasoned applicants.

sentenceSets.sentence: Untangling the estate required three years of litigation, so byzantine were the trusts the old man had layered one inside another.

answerChoices.reasoning: Intricate praises fine complexity of design, but three years of litigation to untangle nested trusts suggests a complexity that obstructs rather than delights.
Fraudulent would mean the trusts were illegal, an accusation the sentence never makes about structures that merely took years to unravel.
Obscure means hard to perceive or little known, while the problem here is the layering of one instrument inside another rather than anything being hidden from view.
Voluminous points to sheer quantity of paper, whereas the sentence emphasizes how the trusts were nested within one another.
Archaic would mean the instruments used outdated forms, which has nothing to do with their being layered inside each other.
Contested describes the litigation itself, not the quality of the trusts that made the litigation last three years.
Generous concerns how much the trusts gave away, which is irrelevant to the difficulty of untangling them.
Informal suggests casual arrangements, at odds with layered trusts drafted to nest within one another.
Straightforward is the opposite of an estate that took three years of litigation to sort out.
Modest describes size and would not explain years of legal work.
Verbal trusts would leave no layered documents to untangle at all.

sentenceSets.sentence: Readers abandoned the novel halfway through, defeated by a byzantine plot in which every character turned out to be someone else's informant.

answerChoices.reasoning: Labyrinthine emphasizes getting lost in passages, while what defeats these readers is a web of concealed allegiances in which everyone secretly reports on everyone else.
Meandering implies a plot that wanders without direction, but this one is densely wired with hidden connections rather than aimless.
Predictable would mean readers saw the turns coming, which cannot be why they gave up halfway defeated.
Derivative means copied from other books, a charge unrelated to the tangle of informants the sentence describes.
Grim describes mood, and the readers quit from being defeated by the plot's construction rather than depressed by its tone.
Lengthy would explain quitting halfway only as fatigue, not as defeat by a structure of hidden allegiances.
Explicit concerns frankness about sex or violence, which the sentence never raises.
Experimental would point to unconventional form, whereas the difficulty lies in who is secretly reporting on whom.
A transparent plot would be easy to follow, contradicting readers defeated halfway through.
Slight means thin and simple, at odds with a novel in which every character conceals a second role.
Wholesome describes moral tone and cannot explain why a plot proved impossible to follow.
